hero.title: Master's in Computer Engineering in Denmark for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Experience innovative Scandinavian engineering education in Denmark with an English-taught Master of Science in Computer Engineering, mastering embedded IoT systems and green microelectronics under updated SIRI stay-back regulations.

overview: Denmark is a global pioneer in user-centered digital systems, green computing technologies, and industrial embedded electronics. Pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Engineering in Denmark provides Indian students with a collaborative, problem-based learning environment focused on architecting energy-efficient digital hardware, autonomous robotics, and smart embedded sensor networks.

Leading Danish research universities—including the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Aalborg University, and Aarhus University—deliver 2-year English-taught Master of Science in Engineering (MSc Eng, 120 ECTS) degrees. Specializations include Embedded Real-Time Systems, Reconfigurable Hardware Computing, Advanced Computer Architecture, Internet of Things Hardware, and Cyber-Physical Systems, developed in close cooperation with Denmark's vibrant commercial electronics industry.

Under regulations administered by the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI), international graduates from state-approved Danish higher education institutions can apply for a post-study job-seeking residence permit. For third-country students whose initial residence permit application for a state-approved master's programme is submitted on or after 1 October 2026, the job-seeking period granted is 1 year (12 months); earlier applications generally retain up to 3 years, and PhD graduates receive up to 3 years regardless of transition date. Graduates may work under applicable statutory permit conditions while seeking qualified employment to transition into the Pay Limit Scheme or Fast Track.
